behaviors.description: Enforce build session-bus ownership and method grants, and observe traffic logging.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent build tree, private session bus, and controlled echo service; unrelated explicit rules keep the proxy enabled.
behaviors.expected: Unrelated rules deny access, own-name acquires the requested name, talk-name enables the echo call, and logging identifies its destination and method without breaking replies.

behaviors.description: Enforce build system-bus ownership and method grants, and observe traffic logging.
behaviors.preconditions: The system-bus address is redirected to a private controlled bus; unrelated explicit rules keep the proxy enabled.
behaviors.expected: Unrelated rules deny access, system-own-name acquires the requested name, system-talk-name enables the echo call, and system-bus logging identifies its destination and method.

mappings.rationale: Real RequestName and echo calls test enforcement, while quiet/logged/quiet calls isolate traffic diagnostics.

surface_assertions.rationale: The grant obtains PRIMARY_OWNER for a name otherwise rejected by the proxy.
The grant changes a denied echo method into a successful reply.
The controlled destination and method appear in logged traffic but not quiet controls.

mappings.rationale: Real ownership and echo calls traverse the system-bus proxy connected to a private bus.
